checks.name: exact_source_scope
checks.detail: Reviewed the current runner-only PCAP parser delta and the unchanged downstream TCP reconstruction/TLS checks; guest hash remains fixed.

checks.name: bounded_hop_by_hop
checks.detail: At most one Hop-by-Hop header, 8..256 bytes, constrained to the IPv6 payload extent; duplicate/other extension headers and fragments fail closed.

checks.name: bounded_options
checks.detail: Each option consumes at least one byte; option lengths cannot exceed header bounds. Only Pad1, zero PadN and a single two-byte Router Alert value 0 are accepted. Unknown options and Router Alert on TCP reject.

checks.name: wrapped_tcp_complete_path
checks.detail: The extracted TCP payload rejoins the same minimum-header, selected-IP-family, port, SYN anchoring, contiguous reassembly, overlap, cleartext signature and complete bounded TLS-record inspection; no extension-triggered TCP skip exists.

checks.name: ipv4_non_tcp
checks.detail: IPv4 protocol other than TCP now raises instead of silently continuing; IPv4 fragments remain rejected.

checks.name: icmpv6_integrity_and_allowlist
checks.detail: All accepted ICMPv6 requires minimum length, code 0 and a complete upper-layer pseudoheader checksum. Only the explicitly classified RS, NS, NA and MLDv2 report subset can be skipped from TCP inspection.

checks.name: mldv2_scope_and_shape
checks.detail: Reports require exactly one Hop-by-Hop Router Alert 0, hop limit 1, link-local source, destination ff02::16, zero reserved field, 1..16 records, record types 1..6, no auxiliary data, <=16 sources per record, multicast group, non-multicast/non-unspecified source addresses and exact final cursor; truncated and trailing data reject.

checks.name: ndp_bounded_subset
checks.detail: RS/NS/NA require no extensions, hop limit 255 and constrained reserved/target/source/option shapes; options are at most one fixed eight-byte source/target link-layer option. This is a bounded observed subset, not a general RFC conformance implementation.

checks.name: original_failure_preserved
checks.detail: Source review and author posthoc parser results do not replace the failed original run verdict or constitute a fresh six-mode QEMU result.
